g.text: Each dot is one vomiting episode at its true time after the last logged feeding, 26 Jul to 11 Nov 2026

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Filled dot: seen as it happened. Outlined dot: found later, so its true time is earlier than drawn. All 29 episodes since 26 Jul are on the chart; none is untimed.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #6b7280

g.text: The two panels use different scales: minutes on the left (dots stack when the minute matches), hours on the right.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #6b7280

g.text: For 10 of the 19 dots in the first 30 minutes the meal was logged in the same sitting as the vomit, so the minute drawn is the owner's estimate, not a clock reading.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Before 26 Jul a bowl of dry food was down all day, so those 30 episodes cannot be timed and are not drawn.
